node.title: XR threshold quotient slopes have an exact radical-lcm image
node.statement: For any finite support family on an affine received line, pass the endpoint restrictions to F^S/(C|_S). The monic gcd of their coordinate forms is basis-independent and is either 1 or one linear bad-slope factor. The radical lcm over every quotient-remainder support and raised agreement therefore has degree exactly equal to the distinct threshold-union quotient slope image. Constructing or bounding that lcm at official scale remains open.
